title: pi-skill-toggle settings
description: Which skills Pi lists for the model (on) and which stay available only on request (off).

version.description: Settings format version. A file without it is read as version 1.

onDemandSkills.description: Skills that are off in every repository. Exact names only.

projects.description: Exact repository overrides, keyed by repository identity (for example `repo:github.com/owner/name`). They win over rules and the global list.

rules.description: Ordered rules. For one skill, the last rule that matches the repository wins. Only repositories with a network origin match.

repo.description: Pattern for the repository identity without `repo:`, for example `github.com/owner/*`. `*` is the only wildcard.

onDemand.description: Skills that are off in matching repositories. `*` is a wildcard.

autoDiscovered.description: Skills that are on in matching repositories. `*` is a wildcard.
